title: Spiritualism wave: seances as common as church

tellings.quote: of these articles in particular said that it was it was as common at the at the height of this thing for an American to get up on a Sunday morning and go to a seance as it was to go to church.

plain: At the height of the spiritualism craze of the 1800s, the belief that the living can talk with the dead, going to a séance on a Sunday morning is said to have been as common for Americans as going to church. The researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels this from periodical articles of the late 1800s and early 1900s that he read, work tied to his project Birthright, and he presents it as a sign of how widely people then sought contact with unseen beings.
